about: Artifacts offered for download on /download/. A release appears once engineering's promotion record approves an exact artifact; it stays 'awaiting the owner's approval', with no download link and no file in any build, until approval.owner names the owner's written approval of that SHA-256 in engineering's docs/DECISIONS.md. The build renders each release and refuses an incomplete record; check.mjs fails on any installer link that is not listed here. Fields: version, stage (private alpha, developer alpha, developer beta, stable), date (YYYY-MM-DD), notes, approval {promotion: the engineering record and its commit, owner: empty until the owner's written approval, then the DECISIONS.md entry, its commit and date; cohort: empty until the testers are named and recorded}, install (sentences shown under 'Before you install'), artifacts [{platform, file, url (https), bytes, sha256, signature}].

releases.notes: Private-alpha candidate 1 of the UCompute desktop app for macOS, built from the development source on 24 October 2026, for invited testers only.
install: The build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so on another Mac macOS refuses the first open of the downloaded app. Open it from the Finder's context menu (Open), or use System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. This has not yet been tried with this build on a second Mac.
The first launch downloads the inference engine (llama.cpp b11609, MIT licensed) and checks its hash, so it needs the internet.
Tested on one Mac: Apple M2, 8 GB, macOS 26.2. Other Macs are not qualified.
Trusted devices (Mesh) are experimental and off by default; this build has not been tested between two machines.
There is no automatic update. The file, the app and its data folder are still named Common.

approval.cohort: Owner's written cohort, 2026-10-29: only the owner's own two emails (the whole UCompute team Access policy), on the stage-snapshot alias; relayed to engineering for D-025 amendment
